task_summary: Solve IPC Airport domain PDDL planning problems by parsing domain/problem files, generating valid plans, and writing them in correct output format
decomposition_rationale: The task has two main concerns: (1) orchestrating the solve pipeline (reading problem.json, invoking planners with appropriate configurations, handling failures/timeouts) and (2) ensuring the output plan format matches what the validator expects. These are tightly coupled enough to fit in 2 skills: a core PDDL solver utility and a plan formatting/output utility.

skills.name: evo-pddl-solver
skills.description: Core PDDL planning solver that parses domain/problem files using unified_planning, invokes pyperplan with optimal search configuration (GBFS + hFF), handles timeouts and fallbacks, and returns a plan object. Also supports direct pyperplan invocation as fallback.
skills.responsibility: Parse PDDL files, configure and invoke planning engines (pyperplan via unified_planning or directly), handle timeout/memout errors, return solution plans
dr_sections: 2. `unified_planning` API for PDDL Parsing and Solving
3. Direct Usage of `pyperplan` as a Fallback
6.2 Best Search Configurations for Agile Limits

skills.name: evo-pddl-plan-formatter
skills.description: Handles plan output formatting and the end-to-end task orchestration: reads problem.json, calls the solver for each task, formats plans in the correct syntax (parenthesized PDDL or function-call style as required by the validator), and writes output files.
skills.responsibility: Read problem.json, orchestrate solving of all tasks, format plan actions correctly (handling case-sensitivity and syntax requirements), write plan files to specified output paths
dr_sections: 5.1 Syntax Conflicts: Standard vs UP Representation
